correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructed: exact flow on each linear saturation region gives return map P and derivative exp(3pi-10.5 E), with E full exterior residence; threshold E*=2pi/7. The frozen center rational brackets and interval verification implementation were inspected; source Hu-Chen Appendix A.3 supplies transverse event order on broad shooting intervals, and new narrower interval inequalities give signs of P(y)-y and E entirely on J1,J2,J3. A fresh independent high-accuracy scipy solve_ivp integration recovered return-displacement signs, approximate E 0.898414,0.8578,1.0023 and multipliers near 0.9915,1.517,0.333, plus central half-period zero at about -0.57902247 with repelling multiplier ~1.004. Antisymmetry Q=-flow(pi), P=Q^2 gives paired orbits and same multipliers; strict inequalities imply local persistence. Numeric integration is corroboration only; the rigorous no-extra-crossing premise is imported from cited primary source and full directed interval proof remains the final certificate. No claim there are exactly seven or no other attractors.
